findingDetails.title: Security replay is not independently observed in this lineage
findingDetails.evidence: sanitizePath uses canonical bases and path.relative, while generate-description uses realpath plus a separator-aware prefix check; source supports containment, but recorded completion depends on tests not replayed here.
findingDetails.recommendation: Replay path-boundary, symlink and identity-safety tests in an authorized verification session.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct comparison of shared sanitizer, description boundary and null-byte, outside-root and symlink regression tests.

findingDetails.title: Containment logic is duplicated at two trust seams
findingDetails.evidence: generate-description maintains a local realpath prefix check while path-utils maintains a canonical relative containment check.
findingDetails.recommendation: Keep the two seams explicitly aligned or centralize them in a scoped follow-up.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct comparison of both implementations and their separate test consumers.
